suppliers: supplier TEXT PRIMARY KEY, region TEXT NOT NULL
receipts: receipt TEXT PRIMARY KEY, supplier TEXT NOT NULL, day TEXT NOT NULL, amount TEXT NOT NULL
dim_versions: version TEXT PRIMARY KEY, digest TEXT NOT NULL, received_at TEXT NOT NULL, applied_sequence INTEGER UNIQUE, retracts TEXT NOT NULL, receipt_count INTEGER NOT NULL, state TEXT CHECK IN (pending, applied, retracted), payload TEXT NOT NULL
dim_members: member_key INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, supplier TEXT NOT NULL, region TEXT NOT NULL, source_version TEXT NOT NULL, valid_from TEXT NOT NULL, valid_to TEXT NOT NULL, tx_from TEXT NOT NULL, tx_to TEXT NOT NULL, seq_from INTEGER NOT NULL, seq_to INTEGER NOT NULL
receipt_origins: receipt TEXT PRIMARY KEY, source_version TEXT NOT NULL, received_at TEXT NOT NULL
fact_links: receipt TEXT NOT NULL, member_key INTEGER NOT NULL, source_version TEXT NOT NULL, received_at TEXT NOT NULL, sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (receipt, sequence)
receipt_assignments: receipt TEXT PRIMARY KEY, member_key INTEGER NOT NULL, sequence INTEGER NOT NULL
